oss.description: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
oss.readme:
Craft Anything

  English · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Tiếng Việt · Português · ไทย

  See how any website, app or game works, then have AI build your own version; an open-source, clean-room engine in pure Rust.
  Point it at a target, say what you want, and it studies the original with real inspection tools,
  has a coding agent build a new project, checks the result against the original and refines it.

  
  
  
  
  
  
  

  

  Download Craft Anything ·
  ArtCraft ·
  All Crafting Apps

  
  
  A website project: each check says how alike the build is, you approve anything outside the rules, and the plan shows what's left.

> [!NOTE]
> **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers,
> filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil
> last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

  How it works ·
  Two ways to use it ·
  AI ·
  Agents ·
  Under the hood ·
  Get started ·
  Status ·
  Downloads ·
  Discord

  
    
      🔍 Study anything
      Websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games and files: real inspection tools find out how they're built and what they do, with the evidence behind every answer.
    
    
      🛠️ Build your own
      Say what you want ("Recreate this website", "Recreate this game's gameplay in Rust") and a coding agent builds a new project in the stack you ask for.
    
    
      ✅ Checked, not guessed
      Every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs) and refined until it's close.
    
    
      🤖 Agent-ready
      320 tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool, so any agent can drive the same engine the app uses. No AI is needed to inspect.
    
  

## How it works

Point Craft Anything at a target, say what you want, and press Start. It works in four steps,
asking you in plain words when a decision is yours:

1. **Study:** inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs.
2. **Build:** a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your
   request names (or a sensible default).
3. **Check:** compare the build with the original and list what doesn't match yet.
4. **Ready:** open, play or preview the result, or ask for changes and it refines it.

  
    
      
      Make: pick what to recreate, say what you want, press Start.
    
    
      
      Ready: play the game, or ask for changes below.
    
  

## Two ways to use it

- **Simple** (default): "What do you want to make?" Pick a website, app or game, describe it,
  press Start. A project page shows the four steps (Study → Build → Check → Ready), what the
  agent is doing in plain words, question and approval cards, how alike the result is, and
  buttons to open the result or its folder. Ask for changes in the box at the bottom.
  "Just look inside" opens a target for questions without building anything (in Deep mode).
- **Advanced**: the full workbench: every tool (Ctrl/Cmd+K), functions, strings, pseudo-C,
  disassembly, hex, call graphs, evidence, unknowns, jobs, logs and the agent console.

Both modes drive the same engine.

## Clean room or Deep

- **Clean room** (the default): nothing inside the original is read, not its code, files or page
  source. Craft Anything works from what you can see: pictures you add, the website as a visitor
  sees it (screenshots, visible text, measured layout, colours, fonts and spacing, menus opened)
  and, when you allow it, a picture of the app's window. Tools that would look inside are refused
  and say how to turn on Deep mode.
- **Deep**: every tool is used, for your private use. A program's code and files are read with the
  built-in engines (and Ghidra when it's installed), a website's JavaScript is read and its start
  page watched, and the builder may use all of them.

Clean room is a rule about what Craft Anything offers and refuses. It is not an operating-system
sandbox: it doesn't isolate your computer. A coding agent you run still acts as you, and what it can
read, write or run depends on its own permissions. Which of an agent's own tools Craft Anything can
refuse differs by agent; for Claude Code's tools in chats and questions, see
[`docs/claude-code.md`](docs/claude-code.md).

Switch in the title bar or Settings, with `settings_set deep_mode true`, or for one CLI run with
`--deep` (or `--clean-room`).

  
  
  Advanced: functions, pseudo-C, the agent and the evidence behind every answer.

## AI

Building needs a coding agent on your computer. **Claude Code** is supported first: Craft
Anything runs your own, unmodified `claude` program, which uses your own sign-in; Craft Anything
never sees or handles your account. Your use of it falls under your own agreement with
Anthropic. See [docs/claude-code.md](docs/claude-code.md) for how and why. A Codex adapter
exists but hasn't been verified on a real install yet. **GitHub Copilot** can use your installed
Copilot CLI through ACP: sign in separately with `copilot login`. **Grok Build** can use your
installed `grok` program through ACP (`grok agent stdio`): sign in separately with `grok login`.
See [docs/grok.md](docs/grok.md). Other agents that speak ACP (Gemini CLI,
Qwen Code, opencode, goose, Hermes, Maki, Devin) can be switched to it per backend; of those, Maki
and Devin have been run live (Devin authenticates with the backend's stored key — its own CLI
sign-in doesn't count over ACP). Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI (Grok, when `XAI_API_KEY` is
set) and local OpenAI-compatible servers are available for questions and analysis (Settings → AI).

## Built for agents

Every tool is also a CLI subcommand and an MCP tool, so an agent can study a target or run a
whole rebuild without the app:

```sh
craft-anything-cli commands                                   # every tool, by toolset

简体中文 · English

  
    
    
  

  DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端。手机上直接跑，也能遥控你电脑上的 DSH。

  
  
  
  

  
  Trendshift 全语言日榜 #1 · 2026-10-30

Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。

     

     

下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

   

  感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱，我将尽快适配 iOS 和鸿蒙！大家 Star 点得越多，我适配得越快哦 hhh

  

  第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
  手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。

本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。

  
    
    
  

插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。

  
    
    
  

原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。

  
    
    
  

分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。

  
    
    
  

横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。

  
    
    
  

主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。

  
    
    
  

中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。

  
    
    
  

手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。敏感操作默认交还给你；放宽应用规则或解除限制前，请先了解风险。

  
    
    
  

## 可以做什么

DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。

- **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。
- **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。
- **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。
- **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。
- **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。
- **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。

功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。

## 安装

安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。

1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。
2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。
3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。

仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。

本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。

## 数据与权限

模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。

“发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。

DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 无关联，也不代表 DeepSeek。使用前请了解：

- **AI 并非万无一失**：回答、代码和操作可能出错，也可能被网页、消息或文件中的恶意指令误导。请核验重要结果；医疗、法律、投资等高风险决策不应仅依赖 AI 输出。
- **工具会产生真实影响**：本机或远程主机上的命令、文件修改及手机操控可能导致数据丢失、隐私泄露、账号、资金或设备损失。免确认、放宽应用规则或解除限制会减少保护；确认与拦截机制不能保证消除所有风险。建议保留默认保护，只授予必要权限，不在存有支付或银行信息的设备上解除限制。详见[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。

## 常见问题

和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？

没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。

安全吗？

本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。

切到后台会被杀吗？

部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。

对手机有什么要求？

Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。

## 从源码构建

以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。

先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git
cd dsh-go

bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh
source tooling/env.sh
flutter --version
java -version

bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon
```

工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。

产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。

构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时：

```bash
bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon
```

未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。

只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行：

```bash
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all
```

## 目录

| --- | --- |
| `app/` | Flutter 界面与 Android Kotlin 平台实现 |
| `packages/dsh_client/` | DSH Web API 的 Dart 客户端 |

| `examples/plugins/` | 插件示例 |
| `docs/guide/`、`docs/plugins/`、`docs/pets/`、`docs/live2d/` | 用户指南、插件开发、宠物包与 Live2D 伙伴制作 |

# UI SDK

A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.

Keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag and drop and the ARIA they need live in `@ui-sdk/core`, with adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components.

  
  

**[Read the docs](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs)**

## Install

UI SDK is in beta. Install core and the adapter for your framework:

```bash
npm install @ui-sdk/react @ui-sdk/core
```

For other frameworks, swap `@ui-sdk/react` for `@ui-sdk/vue`, `@ui-sdk/svelte`, `@ui-sdk/solid` or `@ui-sdk/web`.

Then give your agent the UI SDK skill:

```bash
npx skills add vercel-labs/ui --skill ui-sdk
```

## Example

Every component in UI SDK is built from behaviors. You start by creating the primitive with behaviors.

Don't worry, you don't need to learn how to write this. Your agents will. And we made them really good at it.

```ts
import { createFocusRecovery, definePrimitive } from "@ui-sdk/core"

const searchField = definePrimitive({
  name: "search-field",
  state: () => ({ value: "" }),
  api: (context) => ({
    set: (value: string) => context.store.set({ value }),
    recovery: createFocusRecovery({ fallback: () => context.element("input") }),
  }),
  slots: (slot) => ({
    input: slot({
      attrs: (state) => ({ value: state.value }),
      on: {
        input: (event, { api }) =>
          api.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value),
      },
    }),
    clear: slot({
      present: (state) => state.value !== "",
      attrs: () => ({ type: "button" }),
      press: ({ api }) => api.set(""),
      bind: (el, part) => part.api.recovery.bind(el, part),
    }),
  }),
})

export { searchField }
```

Then render it in your framework with `createParts`. The parts are the same in all five.

### React

```tsx
import { createParts } from "@ui-sdk/react/primitive"
import { searchField } from "./search-field"

const parts = createParts(searchField, { input: "input", clear: "button" })

const SearchField = parts.Root
const SearchFieldInput = parts.Input
const SearchFieldClear = parts.Clear

function Search() {
  return (
    
      
      Clear
    
  )
}

export { Search }
```

### Vue

```vue

import { createParts } from "@ui-sdk/vue/primitive"
import { searchField } from "./search-field"

const parts = createParts(searchField, { input: "input", clear: "button" })

const SearchField = parts.Root
const SearchFieldInput = parts.Input
const SearchFieldClear = parts.Clear

  
    
    Clear
  

```

### Svelte

```svelte

  import { createParts } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/primitive"
  import { searchField } from "./search-field"

  const parts = createParts(searchField, { input: "input", clear: "button" })

  const SearchField = parts.Root
  const SearchFieldInput = parts.Input
  const SearchFieldClear = parts.Clear

  
  Clear

```

### Solid

```tsx
import { createParts } from "@ui-sdk/solid/primitive"
import { searchField } from "./search-field"

const parts = createParts(searchField, { input: "input", clear: "button" })

const SearchField = parts.Root
const SearchFieldInput = parts.Input
const SearchFieldClear = parts.Clear

function Search() {
  return (
    
      
      Clear
    
  )
}

export { Search }
```

### Web Components

Register a custom element for each part:

```ts
import { createParts, wrappedButton, wrappedChild } from "@ui-sdk/web"
import { searchField } from "./search-field"

createParts(searchField, {
  root: "search-field",
  input: { tag: "search-field-input", target: wrappedChild("input") },
  clear: { tag: "search-field-clear", target: wrappedButton },
})
```

Then use them in your HTML:

```html

  
  Clear

```

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) to get the repo
running locally and land a change, and use
[issues](https://github.com/vercel-labs/ui/issues) to report bugs. By
participating, you agree to our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Security

Please do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Instead, follow
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and report responsibly to
[responsible.disclosure@vercel.com](mailto:responsible.disclosure@vercel.com).

## Beta terms

UI SDK is currently in beta and subject to the [Vercel beta terms](https://vercel.com/docs/release-phases/public-beta-agreement);
the framework, APIs, documentation, and behavior may change before general availability.

oss.readme:
# Mister Download Manager

  

Downloads faster than IDM. Free, forever.

🌐 misterdownloadmanager.com: the official website, with the downloads, help and news

  
  
  

  🧩 Browser extension:
  
  
  The Chrome Web Store's is for
   Edge,
   Brave,
   Opera, Vivaldi and Helium too (how).

  
  ⭐ Like it? Give it a star. MDM has no ads and no marketing budget: stars are how people find it.

  Windows 10 and 11 · Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Fedora, openSUSE, Arch and more) · macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, experimental)
  86 languages · no ads, no trial, no sign-up

  
    5×Fastera 1 GB file: 1 s instead of 5.5 s
    +46More languages86 instead of IDM's 40
    100%Cheaper (free!)no licence, no trial, ever
    TorrentSupported fullymagnet links, .torrent files, seeding
  

  
    
    
  

  
  
  
  
  
  
  

| 🚀 [Download](#download) | ⚡ [Why switch](#why-switch-from-idm) | 🖼️ [Screenshots](#screenshots) | ✨ [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) | 📜 [Help and tutorials](docs/README.md) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Why switch from IDM?

**Same window you know. Your downloads finish sooner. And it costs nothing.**

  
    
    
  

| | Mister Download Manager | IDM 6.42 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Download a big file (1 GB) | **1 second** | 5.5 seconds |
| Download a small file | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds |
| Download over a shaky connection | **1.6 seconds** | 5.4 seconds |
| Wait before a download starts | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds |
| Price | **Free, forever** | Paid, after a 30-day trial |
| Ads, nag screens, sign-up | **None** | Registration needed |
| Open source | **Yes** (GPL) | No |

Nothing new to learn: the toolbar, the categories, the list of downloads, the progress window and
the browser button are where you expect them. Measured on the same computer, same files, both
programs at their default settings ([how we measured](#the-benchmark-in-detail)).

## Download

  
  
  

On the [download page](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/releases/latest), pick
one:

| File | Choose it when |
| --- | --- |
| **`...-setup.exe`** | **Not sure? Take this one.** It installs MDM, connects it to your browser and asks your language. |
| `...-portable.zip` | You want MDM on a USB stick or without installing: unzip and run. Everything stays in its folder. |
| `...-x64.zip` | You want the plain programs without an installer. |
| `...-extension-chromium.zip` | You want to add the browser extension by hand (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi). From the stores is easier: [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mister-download-manager/ejoleppdfgjdndddcjoehopknmlglojp), [Add to Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/mister-download-manager/). |

> [!NOTE]
> Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* the first time, because this early version isn't
> code-signed yet. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Or with [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/), Windows' package
manager: in a terminal, the first line installs MDM and the second updates it.

```
winget install AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager
winget upgrade AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager
```

### On Linux

MDM runs on Linux too, tested on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora with GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce
and Cinnamon, on X11 and in Wayland sessions: the tray, dark mode, browser integration (Ubuntu's
Snap Firefox included) and the packages' installs. Not there yet: screen readers (Orca) don't
read its windows, and Flatpak browsers can't reach it ([more](docs/getting-started.md#on-linux)).
Up to version 0.2.4, the files' names end in `-experimental`.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `...-linux-x86_64.deb` | Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS: `sudo apt install ./.deb`. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.rpm` | Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL: `sudo dnf install ./.rpm`. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.AppImage` | Any Linux. Make it executable and run it. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | The plain programs, for any distribution. |

  
    
    
  

### On a Mac? Be the first to try it

Fresh builds for **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel) are on the same download page, marked
`-experimental`: we haven't tried them on a Mac ourselves yet. Give them a go and
[tell us how it went](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues/new/choose); you'll
help make them as solid as the Windows and Linux versions.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `...-macos-arm64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later). Open it and drag MDM to Applications. The first time, right-click the app and choose **Open**. |
| `...-macos-x86_64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with an Intel processor, the same way. |

## 🌍 In your language

Every language Windows 11 offers, **86 in all**. MDM asks on its first start, and you can change
it any time in **View → Language**. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur get a fully mirrored,
right-to-left window.

## Screenshots

  
    One click on YouTube: the Download video button appears over the video.
    Any video on any page: drag the button where you like, it stays there.
  
  
    Watch it fly: every connection's share of the file, live speed and time left.
    Dark mode that follows Windows.
  
  
    Add a download: paste a link, or let MDM catch it from your browser.
    Torrents and magnet links: pick the files you want, skip the rest.
  
  
    A torrent's progress: its files, peers, trackers and pieces, in tabs.
    A video's progress: speed and time left while yt-dlp brings it in.
  
  
    86 languages, chosen by flag on the first start.
    Right to left for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur.
  
  
    Download overnight: queues that start and stop on their own.
    Options where you expect them, every control working.
  

## What it does

- **Speeds up every download** by fetching parts of the file at the same time, and keeps
  re-balancing until the last byte.
- **Resumes** after a crash, a restart or a dropped connection, without starting

oss.readme:
Reverse-engineer any video.

Shot by shot: was it filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it.

Every breakdown is written in **[VIDEO.md](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)**, an open format that agents read layer by layer.

[Website](https://www.reavideo.ai) | [中文](i18n/README_zh.md) | English | [Русский](i18n/README_ru.md) | [日本語](i18n/README_ja.md) | [한국어](i18n/README_ko.md) | [Español](i18n/README_es.md) | [Português](i18n/README_pt.md) | [Français](i18n/README_fr.md) | [Deutsch](i18n/README_de.md) | [Tiếng Việt](i18n/README_vi.md) | [বাংলা](i18n/README_bn.md)

[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/JuneYaooo/rea-video?style=flat)](https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video/stargazers)
![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-%E2%89%A53.10-blue)
![Agent](https://img.shields.io/badge/runs%20in-Claude%20Code%20%7C%20Codex-8A2BE2)
[![Output: VIDEO.md](https://img.shields.io/badge/output-VIDEO.md-3d4fd6)](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)

[![Visit our website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Visit%20our%20website-6644D8?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.reavideo.ai) [![Join our Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join%20our%20Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/dZj8D3GqWT) [![WeChat group](https://img.shields.io/badge/WeChat%20group-07C160?style=for-the-badge&logo=wechat&logoColor=white)](i18n/README_zh.md#社区) [![Follow on X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow%20%40yao__june12106-000000?style=for-the-badge&logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/yao_june12106)

⭐ *Help more people find rea-video. Star this repo!*

Left: a TikTok ad shot on a phone. Right: an AI remake with another product. rea-video's verdict: the left is all live footage, one set and two camera positions; the right is all AI, 8 shots across 3 generations.

## Quick start

rea-video is built for AI agents. In Claude Code, Codex or any agent that can run commands, say:

```text
Install https://github.com/JuneYaooo/rea-video, then break down this video: /path/to/video.mp4
```

The agent installs the CLI, learns the workflow and runs the whole thing. You need ffmpeg and Python 3.10+.

Breakdowns are fully upgraded. Each one gives you two outputs:

- **Report** (`report.html` / PDF), for you: more reader-friendly, with a clearer structure, easier to learn from and to understand how the video was made and how to remake it.
- **[VIDEO.md](https://videomd.github.io/videomd/)**, for your AI: layered, so the AI reads only what a question needs and uses fewer tokens.

You can also hook up a video-capable model (Gemini or Doubao both work) by giving the agent its endpoint and key. That makes the live/AI/3D calls more accurate and adds a reverse-engineered prompt for every shot. It works fine without one; if your agent can see images, it checks the uncertain shots itself.

> Reports are written in whichever language you ask in (Chinese or English). The example reports below are in English.

## What it can break down

| Video type | Examples | What you get |
|---|---|---|
| Live footage | Talking-head, tabletop, handheld product demo, vlog, store visit | Setups and camera positions, framing, camera moves, lighting (12 setups with gear lists), color grade |
| AI video | Text/image-to-video, AI short drama, AI music video | Evidence, a reverse-engineered prompt per shot, how to batch into generations and which model to use |
| Avatar | A portrait driven by audio, lip-sync | Which shots are avatar shots, what portrait and audio you need |
| 3D / animation | Blender / C4D explainers, product animation, 2D animation, stop-motion | Whether to generate with a video model or render from 3D code |
| Code / template | Kinetic type, UI demos, charts, slide-style cards | Text, layout and motion timing, ready to rebuild as a Remotion project |
| Screen recording | Software tutorials, web demos | Which parts are real material you'll need to record yourself |
| Mixed / edits | AI characters + code UI + real screen capture; live footage with AI edits | Each shot judged separately, then reassembled on the original timeline |

Besides how the visuals were made, every breakdown also covers:

- Captions and styled text: start and end of each line (exports to SRT / ASS), plus color, outline and how the text comes in
- Stickers, emoji, picture-in-picture: where they sit and how long they stay
- Editing: where the cuts are, how fast, whether they hit the beat
- Audio: human or AI voice, AI or library music and its BPM, where each sound effect lands
- Material you'll need to supply yourself: screen recordings, screenshots, product photos

## Examples

The sample videos in `docs/cases/videos/` are re-compressed to keep the repo small, which strips the TikTok / Douyin platform tags. So if you run them yourself, you'll get different results from the reports below, especially without a vision model. To reproduce them, use the original downloads from the platform.

Mixed-media clip · 19 s · 10 shots
AI characters talking + code-built UI + 8 s of real screen recording. The 5 dialogue shots are broken up by UI segments but share one set, so a single generation covers all of them.
Video · Report

3D explainer · 67 s · 21 shots
All 3D, AI narration. You can do it in 10 video generations, or have an LLM write Blender / Three.js code.
Video · Report

Product promo · 70 s · 12 shots
83% code-driven motion graphics, 12% screen recording. No video model needed; one Remotion project does it.
Video · Report

AI music video · 165 s · 86 shots
Correctly flags the song as AI-generated (it was made with Suno). The vision model called some shots "live-action drama"; the agent spotted fake Chinese characters on a scroll and ruled them AI.
Video · Report

Live-action unboxing · 72 s · 29 shots
All real footage: an overhead phone rig, one rug, one camera position, no voice-over, room sound plus library BGM. After platform transcoding, the offline tools called 35% of it AI; after agent review it came out

oss.description: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
oss.readme:
Read in: עברית · 简体中文 · 正體中文 · Tiếng Việt · 日本語 · Italiano · Português · Nederlands · Deutsch · Українська · Türkçe · Oʻzbekcha · Français · Español

  
  
  
  
  
  

  

## Start here

| You have | Go to |
|---|---|
| **An Android TV or Google TV** | [Quick start](#quick-start): a coding assistant does the work in about fifteen minutes. |
| **A Samsung, LG, Roku, Vizio or Hisense VIDAA TV** | [cleanyour.tv/not-android](https://cleanyour.tv/not-android): CleanYourTV can't run there, but you can turn off the tracking with your remote. |
| **A phone or laptop, no coding agent** | One of the [community apps](https://cleanyour.tv/app) for Android phones, Mac and Windows, made by independent developers. |
| **Want to see it first** | [What you get](#what-you-get): screenshots of the new home screen. |

**Official links:** [cleanyour.tv](https://cleanyour.tv) and this repo. Other domains using the name, such as
cleanyourtv.com, are not run by this project ([#1004](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/issues/1004)).
CleanYourTV publishes no app in any app store, and clean-your-tv.net is not ours either.

[How it works](#how-it-works) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [What you get](#what-you-get) ·
[Supported TVs](#supported-tvs) · [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand) · [The launcher](#the-launcher) ·
[Restoring](#restoring-your-tv) · [Firmware updates](#after-a-firmware-update) ·
[Questions](#questions-people-ask) · [Contributing](#contributing)

## How it works

Android TVs have the same debug bridge as Android phones. Switch on USB debugging in the TV's
developer options, allow your computer once, and the rest is standard Android tooling:

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Back up** | The list of installed packages and settings. |
| **Disable** | The manufacturer's telemetry, ad services, content rows and preloaded junk, with `pm disable-user`. Nothing is uninstalled, so a restore script can undo every step. |
| **Install** | A small native launcher, made the default home screen. |

**No root, no cable, nothing uninstalled, and a one-line restore if you change your mind.**

The bloat differs by brand, so the prompt has your coding assistant discover it on your TV and ask
before touching anything you might use.

## Quick start

| You have | Do this |
|---|---|
| **A computer** | Use the prompt with a coding assistant: the three steps below. |
| **A computer, no coding assistant** | Run the three steps yourself: the commands are in [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand). |
| **A phone or laptop, no coding assistant** | Pick one of the [community apps](https://cleanyour.tv/app): free, open-source apps built on these TV lists by independent developers. |

The three steps below are written for a coding assistant: the computer needs to be on the same Wi-Fi as
the TV, with a shell on it, plus Python 3, a JDK from 17 through 22, and Android SDK platform 34
with build-tools 34 (the assistant builds the launcher there).
Without an assistant, [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand)
is the same job, run by you, and it has the install commands.

Any of these work: Claude Code (on [0G Private Computer](https://pc.0g.ai/?utm_source=cleanyourtv&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=readme) or an [Anthropic plan](https://claude.com/pricing)), [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli), [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-cli) or [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

| Where | What to do |
|---|---|
| **1. On the TV** | Settings → Device Preferences → About → press OK on **Build** seven times → back → Developer options → **USB debugging** on. If you see a Network or ADB debugging toggle, turn that on too. Keep the TV on. |
| **2. On your computer** | Clone the repo and open that folder in your assistant (`git clone https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv`), then paste [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and fill in your TV model. |
| **3. Follow along** | Accept "Allow USB debugging?" on the TV, then answer the checklist: which apps you use, the dock size and app order, whether to keep the voice assistant, Chromecast and updates. |

Cloning matters: the assistant reuses this repo's `tools/disable.sh` and `launcher/build-and-install.sh`
instead of writing its own, and that is where the backup, the Home guard and the restore record live.

The assistant backs up, debloats, builds and installs the launcher, and checks each step with
screenshots pulled from the TV. With this repo as context it takes about fifteen minutes.

## What you get

A home screen that looks like an Apple TV and gets out of the way:

| Part | What it looks like |
|---|---|
| **A pitch-black home** | A dock of your four favourite apps in a rounded band, where Apple TV puts it. |
| **A top shelf** | Names the focused app in large type, with an ambient glow in a colour taken from its artwork. |
| **The rest of your apps in a grid** | Slides up when you press Down. |
| **One floating glass highlight** | Springs from tile to tile. The focused tile lifts and shows its name. |
| **Three frosted buttons** | Inputs (HDMI ports under the names you gave them in the TV's settings, AV, Live TV), Wi-Fi or Ethernet with the network name, Settings. |
| **A greeting, a thin clock and the date** | In [Outfit](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Outfit), and a matching Clock screensaver. Set `show_stats` in config or a theme for one line under the clock: CPU, free memory and free storage. It stays off unless you turn it on, and it refreshes only while Home is on screen. |
| **Themes and module cards** | Themes change colours, wallpaper, dock and columns without a rebuild, and module cards let other apps plug a tile in, only with your say-so. |

And a TV that stops working against you: no sponsored rows, no "Discover" nags, no analytics
phoning home, no apps you never asked for.

releases.name: wrangler@4.162.0
releases.body:
### Minor Changes

- [#16735](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16735) [`f005593`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/f005593c1ed0d1f429dafc6919c4335f4d5070c7) Thanks [@leostera](https://github.com/leostera)! - Use the local simulator for Artifacts bindings that omit `remote`

  **Behavior change:** Artifacts bindings now default to the local simulator during development, like KV, R2 and D1. Previously, an omitted `remote` in Wrangler and the Vite plugin used the deployed Artifacts resource. If you want deployed repos in `wrangler dev` or `vite dev`, set `"remote": true` on the binding (`dev: { remote: true }` in `cloudflare.config.ts`). Artifacts is in beta, so this ships as a minor release.

  While `remote` is omitted, `wrangler dev`, `getPlatformProxy()` and the Vite plugin warn when remote bindings are enabled, once for each binding rather than on every config reload: "Artifacts binding REPOS uses the local simulator by default. Set `remote: true` to use deployed repos, or `remote: false` to silence this warning." Workers Vitest and `wrangler dev --local` already used the simulator, so they don't warn. Local Artifacts needs no Cloudflare credentials, but requires Git 2.32 or newer on the host.

- [#16749](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16749) [`032f8c2`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/032f8c2b4a9b83970fc4b54de70790b48e3ba373) Thanks [@vaishnav-mk](https://github.com/vaishnav-mk)! - Reject settings on a `workflows` binding to a Workflow declared in `exports`

  A `workflows` binding can still bind a Workflow that the Worker declares in `exports`, but it can no longer set `limits`, `concurrency`, `schedules`, `default_retention`, or `jurisdiction` for it. Set them on the export instead. Previously the binding and the export could both set them as long as they agreed, so configurations that set them on the binding now stop with an error that says which setting to move.

- [#16749](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16749) [`032f8c2`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/032f8c2b4a9b83970fc4b54de70790b48e3ba373) Thanks [@vaishnav-mk](https://github.com/vaishnav-mk)! - Upload Workflow export settings with the Worker

  `wrangler deploy` and `wrangler versions upload` now include the settings of each `workflow` export (`limits`, `concurrency`, `schedules`, `default_retention`, and `jurisdiction`) in the upload, instead of sending only its type and name. Uploads of a Worker with `workflow` exports also send a `Cloudflare-Workers-Script-Api-Date` header, which lets the Workers API provision Workflow exports from these settings as part of the upload. `wrangler deploy` and `wrangler triggers deploy` still create or update each Workflow through the Workflows API afterwards, as before.

  If provisioning a scheduled Workflow fails because the account is on the free plan, `wrangler deploy` now explains that scheduled Workflows require a paid Workers plan.
